horoscope: Try to express openly how you feel today. Also, don't put your health on the back burner. With the Moon in Taurus, a few work-related matters may become confusing, so avoid making decisions in a hurry. Trust your judgement and intuition. With enough effort, you can get through even a difficult task.
love: Under the Venus influence, you may ignore your feelings to make others happy. Today, think about your desires and needs in this relationship. Our astrologer advises that you value your happiness as well as your partner’s.
finance: With Venus’s influence, your financial condition will look improved today. Your income remains steady, but you get a new source of income through your hard work. You might want to invest money in something new. Astrotalk’s astrologer advises you that before making any big investments, you should know the terms and conditions of the deal.
career: If something at the office is bothering you, Mercury encourages you to listen to your gut feeling today. Your past experience and understanding may help you find a way through it. Also, try to avoid unnecessary spending this week. Our astrologers suggest thinking carefully before making decisions about work or money.
health: Today, prioritise your health and avoid working continuously. If you are worried about something, sit alone and give your soul some peace, or talk to a trustworthy person. Mercury’s influence may force you to overthink. Our astrologer advises not to ignore mental fatigue and to take some rest when you need it.
